grounding.excerpt: (2) Perform WET testing at first discharge.

payload.rationale: Part I explicitly requires WET testing at first discharge, which establishes event-triggered special monitoring for parameter WET rather than a recurring monthly DMR numeric limit. The co-located monitoring-table row for Ceriodaphnia dubia (a standard WET test species) with Report Once/5 years corroborates a non-monthly, condition-driven monitoring schedule. The packet does not establish WET as a monthly DMR numeric limit, and no contradiction appears between the two Part I spans.
